name: Frame Other
body:
School abjuration; Level sorcerer/wizard 3

CASTING

Target one beneficiary creature and one scapegoat creature
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

As frame, except you may nominate another person to be protected by this spell and transfer her bad luck instead of your own. You select the spell beneficiary and the framed target, and both must be within range of the spell. Once the spell is cast, the beneficiary may choose which roll she would like to transfer to the framed target, if any.

Frame Other, Greater

School abjuration; Level sorcerer/wizard 5

As greater frame, except you may nominate another person to be protected by this spell and transfer her bad luck instead of your own. You select the spell beneficiary and the framed target, and both must be within range of the spell. Once the spell is cast, the beneficiary may choose which rolls she would like to transfer to the framed target, if any.
